title: AI Platform platform pin
description: environments/{env}/platform.json in ai-platform-deployments: the ai-platform-infra release an environment runs.

release.description: A release tag vX.Y.Z, or the commit SHA itself where the registry entry allows sha refs.

previousRelease.description: The release this pin replaces; null for the first pin of an environment.

requestedBy.description: Exactly one identity, never a name or an email address: entra:{object ID} for a person signed in to the portal, github:{user ID} for an engineer who dispatched the change, app:{slug} for automation. Automatic pins are app:{slug} of the release App.
